items.title: What Is Apollo Global Management (APO) Signaling With Its AI And Global Deal Push?
items.summary: Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO) has begun backing AI startups, expanding its activity beyond traditional private credit and alternative assets. The firm is helping fund the BMG and Concord music deal, adding another large cross border transaction to its deal roster. Apollo is also involved in Daiwa House's minority entry into UK builder Miller Homes, reinforcing its role in international transactions. items.title: AI Spend Has Been 'Critical' for US Economy, Says Torsten Slok
items.summary: AI hardware continued to drive August's increase in import prices, as it has throughout the year. Commodity-price volatility from the Iran war raised the cost of industrial materials at the border. Companies face higher input costs and rising expenses tied to the AI buildout. Torsten Slok, Chief Economist at Apollo Global Management, discusses the Fed's rate decision and role AI investment has played in supporting the US economy.
